public_rationale: The fifteenfold figure has a contemporary basis as reported compute, but that does not verify a fifteenfold increase in model size. Reception was not uniformly negative: the reviewed sources contain clear praise as well as reservations. They provide material counterevidence to Marcus's characterization without establishing a representative consensus. Neither the entire conjunction nor a clean split verdict is adequately established.
limitations: The scale judgment depends on what size means.
A small, search-selected set of reviews cannot reliably establish prevailing opinion.
Positive benchmark results alone would not disprove disappointment relative to expectations.

our_interpretation: Assess both the numerical comparison and the reception claim.
Model size ordinarily means parameter count. Training compute is a plausible alternative in this scaling discussion, but the two measures are not interchangeable.
Generally viewed means a prevailing assessment across independent contemporary reviewers, not the existence of some disappointed reviewers.
Use the launch-to-post reception period, February 17 through March 5, 2025.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable technical disclosures establish a fifteenfold size increase, and a sufficiently broad contemporary review record establishes predominantly disappointing reception.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable size disclosures establish a materially different ratio, or a sufficiently broad contemporary review record establishes that disappointment was not the prevailing reception.
